generalNotes: Locker rooms will be monitored daily. Nothing on the ground, seats, on top etc. No food or drink in locker rooms. All items must be put in the lockers, no exceptions. You must hold each other accountable!
All players: Minimum 2 lifts per week.
Please send medical notes to athletictrainer@kinkaid.org
Open cages/Tarps/Flatgrounds for those in town on Friday and Saturday (10:00 - 11:00 AM)
